description: Create a campaign for the caller's tenant (tenant_id, owner_id and created_by are set from the authenticated user). 'name' required. Optional: description, status (draft|active|paused|completed — default 'active'), start_date/end_date (YYYY-MM-DD), daily_call_target (int, default 0), owner_id (override), script_id, notes, from_email, from_name, email_signature. Duplicate names within the tenant are rejected: if a campaign with the same name (case-insensitive) exists, its id is returned with already_exists=true instead of creating a second. Returns { campaign_id }.

daily_call_target.description: Number of calls planned per day (integer, default 0)

email_signature.description: E-mail signature used for this campaign's mails

name: create_campaign
